common.title: Small things. Worth a replay.
blocks: Three friends. One unfinished guide to everyday life.
Fictional demo: all characters, dialogue, dates and statistics are invented.

common.title: Whose side of the story?
blocks: One small group chat. Three different perspectives.

common.title: You're all set.
blocks: Take your time. These pages won't turn themselves.

common.title: Let's turn back the calendar.
blocks: It started with a group chat that didn't have a name yet.
One thing in common: everyone thought they were organised.

common.title: Good intentions.
blocks: Let's keep this chat for useful things.

common.title: A busy naming department.
blocks: It was supposed to be a place for small weekend plans. Someone fixed a lamp. Someone researched storage boxes. Someone turned a shopping list into an essay.
As the plans piled up, the group tried a few new names. Scroll down to see where they landed.
Plenty of renaming. Still no tidying.

common.title: A quick question.
blocks: Milo began explaining the labelling system.
A short question. An answer with a contents page.

common.title: Technically tidy.
blocks: Milo moved the boxes from the desk to the chair.

common.title: The weekend project.
blocks: They decided to build something together.
Nora planned the steps. Milo wrote instructions. Theo volunteered to test it.
Nothing to test yet. Roles fully assigned.

common.title: A cleaner desktop.
blocks: A bit more empty space would be nice.

common.title: Before buying anything.
blocks: Milo compared a few storage boxes.

common.title: Unboxing.
blocks: Theo opened the new label maker.
Let's put its name on it first.
The label maker became its own first assignment.

common.title: Are we tidy yet?
blocks: The new boxes were neatly lined up.
The old stuff was next to them.

common.title: A different kind of count.
blocks: A lot of little things happened. The numbers coming up are fictional too.

common.title: Messages sent. Tasks pending.
blocks: In this sample group, who did the most typing?
The messages were finished. The to-do list wasn't.

common.title: A small question.
blocks: Every small question finds a way to branch out.
I'll just sit here a minute.

common.title: Back and forth.
blocks: A discussion about the new group icon.
At least give it a colour.
That opened a whole new discussion.

common.title: One sheet of paper.
blocks: From inspiration to filing, all in one afternoon.

common.title: A small mismatch.
blocks: Nora brought four plant pots. Each needed its own drip tray.
Pot number four moved into the sink.

common.title: Special thanks.
blocks: To the one who wrote the instructions.
To the one who revised the plans.
To the one who tried things out.
And to the desk, for staying in one piece.

common.title: That's the group story.
blocks: Now let's give one person the spotlight.

common.title: Your page.
blocks: Not a performance review. Just a few small things worth another look.

common.title: More small things ahead.
blocks: The instructions might never be finished.
But we can still write the next page together.

milo.title: Milo, in many words.
blocks: Explaining every little thing is a talent.

milo.title: Labels for labels.
blocks: This one holds the spare labels.
The system had started organising itself.

milo.title: A watering guide.
blocks: Milo wrote a balcony watering guide. It started with how to hold the watering can.
The paper unrolled. After the instructions came an appendix.
Got it. It's raining, so I'll skip today.
A complete guide. Not needed today.

milo.title: Quick reply.
blocks: To save time, Milo prepared a reusable reply.
One thing to add. There are two possible cases.
A shorter opening. Not a shorter message.

milo.title: Updated contents.
blocks: The notes grew long enough to need a contents page.
Milo added instructions for using the contents page.
Even the way in came with homework.

milo.title: The shortest reply.
blocks: Did you turn the light off?

milo.title: For the one who explains.
blocks: Everyday life doesn't need a manual. With you, it gets one anyway.
No word limit. No shortage of patience.

milo.title: Milo's recap card.
blocks: Explain the little things. Keep the ending short.

nora.title: Nora, with a plan.
blocks: A clear direction. With room for revisions.

nora.title: Free time.
blocks: Nora left a whole afternoon free.
We can do whatever we like.
Then she listed three options for doing whatever they liked.

nora.title: Today's checklist.
blocks: Water the plants. Put the tools on the wall.
Real progress. Still a bare wall.

nora.title: The backup plan.
blocks: Nora checked the weather before heading out.
One route for sunshine. Another for rain.
They spent the afternoon chatting in the doorway.

nora.title: File names.
blocks: The first plan was called Final.
The next one was called New Final.

nora.title: All done.
blocks: Every item on today's list was finally ticked.
That's it. The rest can wait until tomorrow.
Tomorrow's list was already on page two.

nora.title: For the one who adapts.
blocks: You don't have to follow every step to keep moving.
Revise the route. Keep the enthusiasm.

nora.title: Nora's recap card.
blocks: A little progress is worth keeping.

theo.title: Theo, trying things out.
blocks: Want to know what a button does? Ask, then press. Occasionally in reverse.

theo.title: First print.
blocks: The printer did nothing. Theo pressed Print a few more times.
Once they added paper, it got all five.

theo.title: Save location.
blocks: Theo saved the draft in a new folder.
Let's give it a name I'll remember.

theo.title: A change of colour.
blocks: The tea was brewing. A timer tracked how long it had steeped. Theo wanted to change the interface colour.
Restart sent the timer back to zero.
Same colour. How long has the tea been in?
The tea kept brewing. The record started over.

theo.title: Test report.
blocks: Nora asked whether the new button worked well.

theo.title: Instructions first.
blocks: Better prepared for the reading than the task.

theo.title: For the one who tries.
blocks: Every test brings a new discovery.
Sometimes it's which button to press more carefully next time.

theo.title: Theo's recap card.
blocks: Starting over is still a way forward.
